The answer is C, about 15-fold: Maddison-style data puts Japan's real GDP per capita at roughly $1,900–2,000 in 1950 and about $37,000–38,000 in 2016, a multiple near 19–20x. That is closer to 20x than to 5x, so I'm changing my earlier answer of D to C, since the team note limits the choice to 15x or 5x. I haven't verified the note or checked a current dataset, so this rests on my recollection of the data.

CONFIDENCE: 55
